name: use-workflow-editor
title: useWorkflowEditor, useWorkflowCanvasRun
description: useWorkflowEditor and useWorkflowCanvasRun: the workflow-editor block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the workflow-editor block (`npx better-supabase add workflow-editor`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/workflow-editor.
